item.title: Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications
item.description: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
item.description: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.

item.title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
item.description: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

item.title: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing
item.description: Indonesian rescuers said about 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying more than 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea on Sunday.
